we propose a new method of embedding representations that can be applied to any language model, and we demonstrate its efficacy on two different language models, a recurrent neural network and a feedforward neural network.

we propose a new method for compact embedding representation of discrete data, which is a generalization of the discrete autoencoding framework, and we prove its error bound in terms of the number of parameters and the number of symbols in the vocabulary.

we propose an embedding method for discrete symbols that can be used for compact embedding representations, which is based on the combination of a code embedding matrix { W} and an embedding function θe.
